properties.name: eval_const_expr matches independent C99 6.10.1 reference
properties.formal: forall e in Expr (no signed overflow/div0/shift>=64), forall renderings r: eval_const_expr(r) <-> ref_eval(e) != 0

properties.name: eval_const_expr literal-typing boundary matrix
properties.formal: documented edges hold: hex/oct/decimal > i64::MAX unsigned, -1u < 0 false, precedence, ternary right-assoc, trunc division

properties.name: full #if pipeline selects the reference branch
properties.formal: forall macros M, expr e over M/undefined/defined(): token KEEP in output(preprocess) iff ref(e) != 0, DROP iff ref(e) == 0

properties.name: conditional stack state machine vs independent model
properties.formal: forall well-formed conditional programs P (depth<=5): output line k+1 contains L_i iff the model marks source line k active; blank otherwise

properties.name: join_continued_lines equals independent GCC phase-2 splicer and is idempotent
properties.formal: forall sources s: join(s) == splice_ref(s) and join(join(s)) == join(s)

properties.name: strip_block_comments equals independent C11 phase-3 stripper, idempotent
properties.formal: forall text t: strip(t) == strip_ref(t) and strip(strip(t)) == strip(t)

properties.name: string literals preserved verbatim by strip_block_comments
properties.formal: forall pre, lit, post: strip(pre + \n + lit + post) contains lit verbatim

properties.name: stringification follows C11 6.10.3.2 reference
properties.formal: forall well-formed args a: tokens(preprocess(#define S(x) #x ; S(a))) == [stringize_ref(a)]

properties.name: token pasting concatenates raw operands (direct and via indirection)
properties.formal: forall idents x,y: tokens(CAT2(x,y)) == [xy]; tokens(CAT2(x,)) == [x]; tokens(XCAT(x,y)) == [xy]

properties.name: preprocess token stream equals gcc -E -P on generated macro programs
properties.formal: forall programs P in grammar (defines incl. empty-bodied object-like, function-like with #/##/__VA_ARGS__/,## __VA_ARGS__, content lines): tokens(preprocess(P)) == tokens(gcc -E -P(P))
properties.counterexample: #define VAC(fmt, ...) g(fmt, ## __VA_ARGS__) + VAC(a, ) -> SUT [g ( a )], gcc [g ( a , )]

properties.name: empty-macro anti-paste guard KAT (gcc differential)
properties.formal: forall op in {-,+,/,<,=}: tokens(preprocess(#define EMPTY; <op>EMPTY<op>)) == tokens(gcc -E -P(same))

properties.name: line-number preservation and __LINE__ correctness
properties.formal: forall plain sources: out.lines == src.lines + 1 and __LINE__ on source line k expands to k

properties.name: #line override respected by __LINE__
properties.formal: forall target in 1..1000, gap in 0..4: after `#line target`, the line at distance gap+1 reports __LINE__ == target + gap

properties.name: #error/#warning diagnostic contract (active vs inactive branches)
properties.formal: forall msg: after set_filename(t.c), preprocess with #error msg on active line L yields errors() == [(file=t.c, line=L, col=2)] and nothing from inactive branches

properties.name: pragma contract table (sweep round)
properties.formal: forall op sequences from {pack(N), pack(), pack(push,N), pack(push), pack(pop)}: synthetic tokens match the README table; weak/redefine_extname side channels recorded; push_macro/pop_macro restores a definition across #undef

bugs.summary: , ## __VA_ARGS__ deletes the comma for a supplied-but-empty variadic argument (gcc keeps it)
bugs.impact: Wrapper/generated code calling variadic macros with an explicit empty last argument silently loses the comma and changes expansion arity (g(a, ) becomes g(a)); downstream C parses with the wrong argument count and no diagnostic.
bugs.expected: tokens [g ( a , )] — the comma survives a supplied-but-empty variadic argument (gcc 9.4 behavior)
bugs.actual: tokens [g ( a )] — the comma is deleted as if the variadic arguments were absent
bugs.counterexample: #define VAC(fmt, ...) g(fmt, ## __VA_ARGS__) + VAC(a, ) -> SUT [g ( a )], gcc [g ( a , )]
bugs.fix: In handle_stringify_and_paste's ## handling (macro_defs.rs:856 area), delete the comma only when the variadic argument list is ABSENT (args.len() == named_count), not when get_va_args returns an empty string for a supplied empty argument.

bugs.summary: #error/#warning diagnostics carry an absolutized file path instead of the input filename
bugs.impact: Every user-facing diagnostic printed by the driver (src/driver/pipeline.rs:388 formats err.file:line:col) shows a host-absolute path where gcc shows the input path, and contradicts __FILE__ ("t.c") from the same run.
bugs.expected: errors()[0].file == "t.c" (the name given to set_filename, matching __FILE__)
bugs.fix: current_file (pipeline.rs:649) should return self.filename when the include-stack top is the main file (or set_filename should remember the raw name alongside the make_absolute push at pipeline.rs:632).

bugs.summary: empty object-like macro expansion glues adjacent operator tokens (-EMPTY- becomes --)
bugs.impact: Silent token mutation in preprocessed output fed to the lexer: - - becomes --, + + becomes ++, / + / becomes a // comment. Empty helper macros adjacent to operator tokens change program meaning with no diagnostic.
bugs.expected: tokens [-, -] (gcc -E -P emits a separating space at the empty expansion site)
bugs.actual: tokens [--] (append_with_paste_guard early-returns on empty expansions, skipping the trailing-edge anti-paste check)
bugs.fix: In append_with_paste_guard (macro_defs.rs:253), when expanded is empty still run the trailing-edge would_paste_tokens check between result's last byte and next_byte and insert a space when needed.
